LXCat, www.lxcat.net
Generated from local cs_tabata.txt for IEC Research.

RECOMMENDED REFERENCE FORMAT
- Tabata & Shirai (2000) database, www.lxcat.net, retrieved on December 23, 2025.

CROSS SECTION DATA FORMAT
In downloaded files, each collision process is defined by a block consisting of
1st line: Collision type (ELASTIC, EXCITATION, IONIZATION, etc.)
2nd line: Target and product species
3rd line: Threshold energy (eV) or mass ratio
4th+ lines: Comments and reference information
Finally: Table of cross section vs energy
